## Choose a pull request template

This repository uses separate templates for bug fixes and features. Open a compare URL with your topic branch (replace `your-branch`), or append `?template=` / `&template=` on the pull request creation page:

- **Bug fix (`Fix`)** — Resolved changelog entries  
  `https://github.com/Krypton-Suite/Standard-Toolkit/compare/master...your-branch?quick_pull=1&template=fix.md`
- **Feature / enhancement (`Feature`)** — Implemented changelog entries  
  `https://github.com/Krypton-Suite/Standard-Toolkit/compare/master...your-branch?quick_pull=1&template=feature.md`

For the fuller local draft (embedded screenshots and build-log images under `Documents/PR/`), copy from [`Documents/PR/TEMPLATE.md`](https://github.com/Krypton-Suite/Standard-Toolkit/blob/alpha/Documents/PR/TEMPLATE.md). Do not upload those images to the GitHub pull request.
